ownership.quote: Gcore is an edge AI, cloud, network, and security company headquartered in Luxembourg. Type: Privately held company. Founded February 27, 2014. Founder Andre Reitenbach.

stage.quote: Cyprus-headquartered video game publisher Wargaming has led a $60m series A round for Luxembourg-based edge AI technology developer Gcore.
stage.note: This was Gcore's first and only disclosed external funding round, ten years after founding (bootstrapped/self-funded 2014-2024).

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum equals the single disclosed Series A round; Wikipedia states it was 'the company's first external investment since its founding.'
total_funding_usd.quote: In July 2024, Gcore raised $60 million in a Series A funding round, marking the company's first external investment since its founding.

last_round.quote: Cyprus-headquartered video game publisher Wargaming has led a $60m series A round for Luxembourg-based edge AI technology developer Gcore. Venture capital firms Constructor Capital and Han River Partners also took part in the round, which represents Gcore's first external funding since it was founded in 2014.

revenue.quote: Gcore's estimated annual revenue is currently $94.6M per year.

note: Gcore (founded 2014 in Luxembourg by Andre Reitenbach) is a privately held, independent edge AI/cloud/CDN/security provider. It operated bootstrapped/self-funded for a decade before taking its first and only disclosed external funding — a $60M Series A in July 2024 led by video-game publisher Wargaming (a long-time customer), with Constructor Capital and Han River Partners participating. No accelerator/incubator affiliation found. Gcore's own About page lists 600+ team members (2026); Wikipedia cites 500+ (2023); Growjo lists 502 with an estimated $94.6M ARR — treat revenue as a rough third-party estimate, not company-confirmed.
